relevance_rank_note: Starting reference for H2 and the only paper tying ARF6 to an ApoE4 receptor-recycling defect: direct surface-biotinylation of ABCA1 in ApoE3 vs ApoE4 mouse primary astrocytes plus ARF6 levels, but the recycling/compartment evidence is HeLa colocalization with recombinant ApoE, and ARF6 knockdown was read out only by cholesterol efflux, never by ABCA1 surface level or recycling.

description: Surface-biotinylated (membrane) ABCA1, normalised to total, was lower in ApoE4 than ApoE3 targeted-replacement mouse primary astrocytes, while total ABCA1 protein and ABCA1 mRNA did not differ (Fig 1D, 1G), consistent with a trafficking rather than expression defect; membrane ApoE trended lower without a significance mark.
quote: However, membrane ABCA1 levels were significantly lower in ApoE4 primary astrocytes compared with ApoE3 (Fig. 1D, top, and F).
summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (less plasma-membrane ABCA1, total ABCA1 unchanged)
system: Primary cortical astrocytes from 1-3 day-old neonatal human APOE3- vs APOE4-targeted-replacement mice (Taconic), ~95% astrocytes after shaking off microglia/OPCs; endogenous ApoE; sulfo-NHS-SS-biotin surface biotinylation, NeutrAvidin pulldown, Western blot, membrane/total ratio, Na/K-ATPase membrane control. Mouse (humanised APOE knock-in) neonatal astrocytes in vitro.
human_check: Results text cites 'Fig. 1D, top, and F' but the legend puts the membrane/total blot in panel E (D is mRNA); location given as Fig 1E-F per legend. Effect read off Fig 1F bar (E4 ~0.38-0.40 of E3). Class 1 -> 3 (team leader, 2026-11-21): steady-state surface level is B' in the directness guide; synthesis or breakdown could also change it, so it does not measure recycling itself.

description: Total ARF6 protein was higher in ApoE4 than ApoE3 targeted-replacement mouse primary astrocytes by Western blot; this is the paper's proposed mechanism for diverting ABCA1 to late endosomes.
quote: We found greater protein levels of ARF6 in ApoE4 primary astrocytes compared with ApoE3 primary astrocytes (Fig. 1H,I).
summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (more ARF6 protein) [proposed -> less ABCA1 recycling]
system: Primary cortical astrocytes from neonatal (1-3 d) human APOE3- vs APOE4-targeted-replacement mice; total-lysate Western blot for ARF6 normalised to beta-actin. Mouse neonatal astrocytes in vitro.
human_check: p=0.02 is printed on the Fig 1I graph, not in text/legend (legend key is only ***p<0.001). Total ARF6 only; the paper never measures ARF6 activity although its model and intro speak of ARF6 activation. Exact P printed on the figure panel itself (coded printed_in_text).

description: In HeLa cells stably expressing GFP-ABCA1, a 30-min exposure to recombinant ApoE4 vs ApoE3 increased ABCA1 colocalization with LAMP2 (from roughly 45% to 56%, about 11 percentage points), interpreted as trapping in late endosomes/lysosomes.
quote: Greater colocalization of ABCA1 with the late endosome marker LAMP2 and lower colocalization with the recycling endosome marker Rab11 were observed in cells treated with rApoE4 compared with rApoE3 (Fig. 2).
summary: (rApoE3 -> rApoE4) -> (more ABCA1 in LAMP2+ late endosome/lysosome)
system: HeLa (human cervical carcinoma) cells stably transfected with ABCA1-GFP, treated 30 min with 200 nM (0.2 uM) recombinant human ApoE3 or ApoE4; fixed, anti-LAMP2 immunofluorescence, confocal, LAS-X colocalization percentage, blinded acquisition. Non-neural human cancer line overexpressing tagged ABCA1; exogenous lipid-free recombinant ApoE.
human_check: eff is a percentage-POINT difference in % colocalization (~45 -> ~56), following the paper's own subtraction convention (Methods), not a relative change. n counted from dots (~19-20 per group); the unit (cell vs field) is not stated. Text calls LAMP2 a late-endosome marker, legend calls it lysosomal.

description: In the same GFP-ABCA1 HeLa system, recombinant ApoE4 vs ApoE3 (30 min) lowered ABCA1 colocalization with the recycling-endosome marker Rab11 (from roughly 66% to 58%, about 8 percentage points).
quote: Greater colocalization of ABCA1 with the late endosome marker LAMP2 and lower colocalization with the recycling endosome marker Rab11 were observed in cells treated with rApoE4 compared with rApoE3 (Fig. 2).
summary: (rApoE3 -> rApoE4) -> (less ABCA1 in Rab11+ recycling endosomes)
system: HeLa cells stably expressing ABCA1-GFP, 30 min 200 nM recombinant human ApoE3 vs ApoE4; anti-Rab11 immunofluorescence, confocal colocalization percentage. Non-neural human cancer line; overexpressed tagged receptor; exogenous recombinant ApoE.
human_check: eff is a percentage-point difference (~66 -> ~58) read off the dot plot. This and the LAMP2 row are the paper's only 'recycling' evidence; no recycling-rate assay (e.g. biotin recycling or antibody-feeding) was done anywhere in the paper.

description: The ABCA1 agonist peptide CS-6253 (1 uM, 30 min) raised ABCA1-Rab11 colocalization in recombinant-ApoE4-treated GFP-ABCA1 HeLa cells by 11% (relative increase, Fig 6B means about 53 to 59) vs ApoE4 alone (12 with CS-6253 alone), a partial rescue of the ApoE4 recycling-compartment shift; no ApoE3 arm in this panel.
quote: Compared with cells treated with rApoE4 only, ABCA1 colocalization with Rab11 significantly increased by 11% upon cotreating cells with rApoE4 plus CS-6253 and by 12% with CS-6253 alone (Fig. 6A,B).
summary: (rApoE4 + CS-6253 vs rApoE4) -> (more ABCA1 in Rab11+ recycling endosomes)
system: HeLa cells stably expressing ABCA1-GFP, 0.2 uM recombinant ApoE4 with or without 1 uM CS-6253 (ApoE C-terminal-derived alpha-helical ABCA1 agonist) for 30 min; Rab11 immunofluorescence, confocal colocalization. Non-neural cancer line; overexpressed tagged ABCA1; exogenous recombinant ApoE4.
human_check: The printed 11% is a percentage-point difference (paper subtracts colocalization rates). Contrast is drug vs vehicle within ApoE4, not ApoE4 vs ApoE3. n counted from dots per group.

description: In ApoE4-TR mouse primary astrocytes, 4 h CS-6253 (1 uM) lowered total ARF6 protein by roughly half, while membrane ABCA1 rose only as a non-significant trend (p=0.07, Fig 5B) and total ABCA1 was unchanged; links the rescue to ARF6 but the surface-ABCA1 rescue itself did not reach significance.
quote: CS-6253 increased the relative amount of ABCA1 on plasma membrane and significantly decreased total ARF6 protein expression in ApoE4-treated cells (Fig. 5A–C).
summary: (APOE4 astrocytes + CS-6253) -> (less ARF6; membrane ABCA1 trend up, n.s.)
system: Primary astrocytes from neonatal human APOE4-targeted-replacement mice, 1 uM CS-6253 for 4 h; surface biotinylation for membrane ABCA1 and total-lysate Western blot for ARF6 (normalised to actin). Mouse neonatal astrocytes in vitro; ApoE4 only (no ApoE3 comparator); pharmacological agent.
human_check: Statistics are for the ARF6 decrease (Fig 5C, ~0.54 of vehicle, ***). The membrane-ABCA1 increase in Fig 5B (~1.33 of vehicle) is marked p=0.07 on the graph, yet the Results text says CS-6253 'increased' membrane ABCA1 without flagging non-significance. Not filed as its own row: it compares drug vs no drug within APOE4, not APOE4 vs APOE3 (team leader, 2026-11-19).

description: ARF6 siRNA knockdown in ApoE4-TR mouse primary astrocytes increased ABCA1-mediated cholesterol efflux vs scrambled siRNA (about 12% at 4 h, about 20% at 24 h); the only ARF6 loss-of-function experiment in the paper, and its readout is efflux, not ABCA1 surface level or recycling.
quote: Knockdown of ARF6 by siRNA resulted in significant increase in cholesterol efflux in ApoE4 primary astrocytes after 4 and 24 h (Fig. 3C–E).
summary: (APOE4 astrocytes, ARF6 knockdown) -> (more ABCA1-mediated cholesterol efflux) [surrogate for restored ABCA1 recycling]
system: Primary astrocytes from neonatal human APOE4-targeted-replacement mice, ARF6 siRNA (200 nM, jetPRIME) vs scrambled; 3H-cholesterol efflux to BSA-containing medium at 4 h and 24 h, normalised to scrambled. Mouse neonatal astrocytes in vitro; ApoE4 only (no ApoE3 arm).
human_check: Values are for the 24 h panel (Fig 3E); 4 h (Fig 3D) is ~12%, also p=0.03 printed on graph. Knockdown duration conflicts: legend says 48 h, Methods say ARF6 assessed 72 h after transfection. No n given for Fig 3D-E. This is the single cholesterol-efflux row allowed. Exact P printed on the figure panel itself (coded printed_in_text).
